steps.name: Leto
steps.text: A game?

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: You don't want Mamochka to leave for her adventure, right? I don't want to make my darling crybaby weep by vanishing into thin air either, so let's play a little game.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I'm not a crybaby!

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: I remember the wailing at our reunion on the landship bridge, isn't that what you'd call a—

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Stop, stop, stop! It's not like I'm trying to keep you from stepping out, but you haven't fully recovered yet! So what's with the game?

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: Oripathy can't be cured, so what even counts as 'fully recovered'?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: I know you're concerned about me, but the best medicine for us adventurers is always a sight we've never seen before.

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: Most importantly, do you think you could really stop me from going if I really wanted to?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Fine, I get it.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: So, what game is this?

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: A simple one. Hide and seek.

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: Tomorrow, I'll hide somewhere on the ship. Find me in the afternoon, and I'll stay.

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: But if you don't, you have to give up on trying to stop me.

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: Well?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hey, this landship is humongous!

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: You can ask anyone to help you out. Does that make it fair?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Aw—fine!

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: I'll go pack up my luggage then. You should get an early night, lapochka.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hmph, don't get too happy yet. I'll definitely find you.

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: Now that's my daughter. I'll be waiting for you.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Alright, better get an early night.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I have to find Mamochka tomorrow.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Oh, I should probably message the gang before I sleep.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: 'Look out for my mamochka tomorrow. More deets in the cafeteria.'

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Alright, sent.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Sheesh, Mamochka makes me look like a good girl by comparison.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Time to snooze.

a.text: Mamochka, are you going out again?
Yes, be good at your aunt's place. Mamochka will bring you a souvenir.
I want to go with you.
No can do. It's too dangerous for you. When you're older and stronger, I'll take you along with me.
Really?
Of course, I promise.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Didn't see her.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Yeah, figured.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: What's that supposed to mean?!

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I'm afraid I didn't see her either.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Aren't you pretty chummy with her?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: We occasionally exchange makeup tips, that's all.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: What about you, Anna?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Sorry.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Lada... forget it, I'm guessing you didn't see Mamochka either. Seems like she's serious about this.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Huh? I saw her.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Yeah, she came pretty early for breakfast.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You should've told me!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: But you were still sleeping. Also, you didn't tell me to let you know ASAP.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Ugh, fine.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Did she mention where she was headed?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I was cooking then, so I didn't really catch it... but I heard her mention Instructor Dobermann.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Instructor Dobermann? Come to think of it, she is helping Mamochka with her rehab.

spans.text: Instructor Dobermann? Come to think of it, she

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Thanks. Let me know if anything else happens—

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Just a moment.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: You have yet to explain to us what's going on.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Ugh, fine.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Huh. So it's just a game? I thought something serious was going down.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: It's not just a game! If I lose, Mamochka's going out on her adventure!

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Why not let her go? Wouldn't it be good for her?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You're asking why? Mamochka has Oripathy, you know.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: But—she showed us her physical results last time we ate together, and said her condition's stable now.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Even so, you can't just take off right away, right?!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Anna's, what's with that look?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Nothing. I just thought it was quite strange to hear that coming from your mouth, when you're the flightiest one here.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Agh, anyway, just let me know if you see her before dinner!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I'll head over to Instructor Dobermann first.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Rosalind becomes a totally different person the moment you bring up her mother.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: It's the one thing she's guilty about, after all.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Gospozha Tatyana Larina contracted Oripathy on her account, so it's no wonder she's rather hung up about it.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Do you think Gospozha Larina requires our concern?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Fine... she probably wouldn't back down even with all of us united.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: So, let's just help Rosalind out, and leave the rest to them.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Instructor Dobermann!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Morning, Leto.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Did you see my mamochka today?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Señora Tatyana? I did see her earlier.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Is she still around?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: No, we only had a brief chat before she left, probably went to get ready for her trip.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Did she talk about anything else besides that?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: I think she knew you'd come here, and asked me to pass this to you.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: These are—?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Climbing ropes.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Is this what she usually uses?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Yes. Well, you have your own classes and missions, so it's no surprise this is new information to you.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Señora Tatyana may not be exceptionally strong, but she is extremely nimble. She holds the record for scaling that wall over there.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Can I try too?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: I figured you'd ask. Come with me.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Alright, the rope's set. Go ahead.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Mamochka probably hid something on top of the wall, if she left these ropes for me.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Right, just watch me climb this quick and we'll see what she's hiding up there!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hup!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Uwaa!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Rock climbing isn't as simple as it looks. You have to find your fulcrum and control your balance. It's not something you can brute force your way through.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Again!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I got it! The next one—

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I can't reach that one at all!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: You have to propel yourself up with your momentum. You shouldn't be standing on that hold either.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Momentum?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Oh—I get it!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Again!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hah, so that's the way!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Heheh, half way up now!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Next one! Watch me!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Damn!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Uaaagh!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: That was dangerous, but no matter. Just a little more to go!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: If I want to go up from here, you'd normally step on this hold, and then climb up from there.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hm? Seems like it'd be faster if I use this other one—

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hehe, let's give it a shot!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Watch me!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Heh! Safe and sound!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Now let's see—

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Aha, I knew it.
A book quietly sits on the platform at the top of the climbing wall.
Leto makes her way over and realizes she has seen this book before.
She picks up the book and walks to the platform's edge. She has a good view of the entire training room from this spot.
But, she suddenly gets a feeling—
What Mamochka saw while sitting here was definitely not the training room, but some scenery etched into her mind.
Because the book she just picked up is a travel magazine—with an article mentioned on the cover written by her mother.

a.text: Mamochka, what's this?
A travel magazine. Mamochka has an article published in it.
An article?
Mhm. My job is to turn my adventures into essays. Look, this is a photo from my last expedition.
Wow, it's pretty.
Right? This is how I keep us fed. It used to be something I had the most fun doing, but now, I have to work as hard as I can for the both of us.
Mamochka, you should take it easy.
Don't you worry. I'm happy going to these places, just like I'm happy when you're with me. Oh, how nice it'd be if we could go discover a new place together one day!
Yeah, I want to go together with you, Mamochka!
Haha, you'll have to grow up big and strong first, little Roza!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Leto, did you find something?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Technically yes, but also no...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: This magazine—

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Her travel article's in it.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Leto, do you resent your mother for not staying with you?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Well... Mamochka travels a lot, so it's true she isn't with me much, but her absence feels different from me not having a father.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Because Mamochka always comes home with a ton of interesting stories for me.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Words I've never heard before, sights I've never seen—Hearing Mamochka talk about all that stuff is much more interesting than if she were to just stay with me.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: I see.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: And that's why you're so hung up on this. Both you and Señora Tatyana have always had an extraordinary mother-daughter relationship.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: But Oripathy has tied a knot in your bond.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Mhm.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I know what Mamochka wants, and I know it's the best for both of us, and yet—

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: She wouldn't be sick if she didn't go into Chernobog to find me.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I just can't manage to convince myself.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Which is why I try to stop her from going out on adventures instead.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I know how exactly I could keep her here, but I actually don't want her to stay.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: She'll understand you, I'm sure.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: She wouldn't be playing this game with you otherwise, no?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: I think she's prepared an answer for you.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: ...Yeah.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Rosalind, I did a little investigating. It seems your mother has left a lot of smokescreens around.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I don't think you'll find her in time, if you check them one-by-one.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Are there any unusual clues she might have left you?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Unusual...?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: From what I know about Mamochka, she'd definitely leave me some hint in this kinda game...

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: I remember the wailing at our reunion on the landship bridge, isn't that what you'd call a—

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Ah!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I got it!

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: You got it?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Oh, the bridge!

a.text: Rosalind, my lapochka!
Mamochka?! Wh-What are you doing here?!

I heard something happened in Chernobog and came as soon as I could, but the place was already in ruins by the time I arrived. I couldn't find you no matter how hard I tried, but I'm so glad you're not hurt!
Heheh, why would I be? But how did you even end up here, Mamochka?
Well... it's a long story. Anyway, I heard from a Rhodes Island doctor that you were here.
Why would Rhodes Island—Wait, Mamochka?! Those crystals—Why do you have Oripathy?!
Ah. Oopsies. I-it's nothing, really. Don't worry, your Mamochka was just careless—
...Mamochka, did you get sick because of me?
N-No, it was from an adventure...
Ma... it's all my fault—
Oh, don't cry. A little illness is nothing, as long as you're okay.
*sob* Uwaaaaaaah———!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Mamochka talked about when she first arrived at Rhodes Island! I should've connected the dots last night!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I turned into a sobbing mess while hugging my mamochka right here!

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: But I don't see anyone else here?

steps.name: Human Resources Operator
steps.text: Oh, Leto and Rosa. What are you girls doing up here?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Have you seen my mamochka?

steps.name: Human Resources Operator
steps.text: Hm? Tatyana? Can't say I have.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Human Resources Operator
steps.text: But she did leave a bag here, and I was worrying over it. Why don't you hand it back to her?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Lemme take a look!

steps.name: Human Resources Operator
steps.text: Over here, it's pretty heavy.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: This is—

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: A brand new outdoor camping set, and a book series on polyglot secrets?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hmph. She had me figured out, and knew I would come here.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Huh? There's a letter too.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: 'For my dear daughter'. Whoa, she even drew a smiley. It's mocking me.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Gospozha Larina would indeed do such a thing, knowing her.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: You should open it.
Lapochka, your aunt told me I should be spending more time with you.
But you know how I am. I'm well aware I'm not doing a great job as a mother—I've tried, but in the end, I felt it was impossible.
I've agonized over this for a long time, but the one who sweeps all the agony away is you.
You always greet me when I come home, with your smile full of anticipation and joy washing all my anxieties away.
You eagerly listen to every tale I tell you.
The funny school stories you tell me always make me laugh out loud.
You tell me with your actions—it's alright for me to act like this, and we can base our relationship on that.
You don't know this, but it's a way for Mamochka to redeem herself, and I'm not exaggerating.
Because this means I can love both you and my work.
Of course, we have fun together, but when we're apart, I'll be happy if I know you are too. And you'll be happy if you know I'm happy.
Isn't this how we've been the last few years?
I know you feel guilt over my Oripathy, and that's why you're always volunteering to see those sights in my stead.
But losing you is what I fear most. As long as you're healthy and happy, this illness isn't much at all.
And now, we've both found our own meaningful paths to walk on, in a sense.
So, I hope you can look after your own life better, just like you have in the past.
Become a beacon, just like 'General Leto'.
And likewise, your Mamochka will take good care of herself.
Alright?

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: My daughter should have found the letter by now.

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: Even if she didn't, someone else will, and they'll have passed it to her.

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: Don't blame Mamochka, lapochka.

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: We've never needed so many words between us, right?

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Being your daughter's hardly the easiest job in the world.

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: Ah, here you are, little Asbest.

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: You can drop the 'little'. I insist.

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: You never intended to let your daughter find you in the first place, huh?

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: She is dear to me, but so are my adventures.

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: This aircraft is a part of Rhodes Island, so I technically didn't lie to her, did I?

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: As it goes in the family—we always mean what we say!

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Suit yourself. I just think it's pretty miserable for her.

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: Just you wait. You'll understand in the future when you find your own fork in your path, little Asbest.

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Heh, the only future I see is dying on an expedition.

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: What a coincidence. I used to think the same.

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: For real though, why didn't you go looking for Magallan? Why tag along with me?

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: The route little Maggy was taking does have its charms, but I still prefer a more challenging environment.

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: Don't you think our tastes are pretty similar in that regard?

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Hmph, I should've dumped you here and set off on my own.

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: The Doctor would be sad to hear that, you know?

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Who cares.

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: *sigh* I actually planned to go out alone, if the Doctor hadn't insisted otherwise.

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: Buuuut, if you really aren't too keen to tag along with me, I could perhaps have a word with the Doctor...

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Gah. Arghhhh. Alright, alright, we'll go together, yeah?

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: That's more like it!

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: Are we ready to go, ladies?

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: Let's go!

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: *sigh*... I have a feeling this expedition is gonna be the second noisiest of my life.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Rosalind!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Nothing here either. You... what's up?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: ...Uh, forget about it.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Huh? But—

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I lost. Mamochka's too crafty.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Tissue for you, Rosalind.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I'm not crying though.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I swore on that day to never cry again.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I'll smash every annoying thing into bits with a smile on my face.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Hmph. Acting tough?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Yeah? Got a problem with that?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Argh, let's get a move on already! It's chow time!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Dinner's on me today, and I'll eat Mamochka's share too!
